title: For Lisa Eldridge, Vintage Makeup Is a Portal to the Past — and a Mirror for the Soul
summary: “Makeup is human history. It reflects our need to paint, to be creative, to be expressive,” said Lisa Eldridge, who has built a private museum in London for her vast vintage cosmetics collection.
